quest.4119CBCB390A95C4.title: &6Copper Gear&r
quest.4119CBCB390A95C4.quest_desc: Craft a full set of &6Copper Armor&r — the first real protection upgrade beyond &7Leather&r.
&aSits between Leather and Iron&r in defense, and is &leasier to mass-produce&r thanks to abundant copper veins.
&eBonus&r: copper gear &7oxidizes over time&r, giving it a distinctive patina.
quest.minecraft:white_wool.title: &fWool
quest.minecraft:white_wool.quest_subtitl: The thread of every adventurer's gear.
quest.minecraft:white_wool.quest_desc: &7Shear a sheep or craft 4 &fstring&7 into a wool block.
&eUsed for:&7 beds, banners, carpets, paintings, and most importantly the bedding of &6Apotheosis Boss&7 spawners and altars.
&eDye it&7 any color to color-code your storage or banner system.
&aA staple resource — never travel without a stack.
quest.minecraft:wooden_sword.title: &7Wooden Sword&r
quest.minecraft:wooden_sword.quest_subti: &7The first step on the gear ladder.&r
quest.minecraft:wooden_sword.quest_desc: Craft your first &7Wooden Sword&r from &62 Planks&r and &71 Stick&r.
&aApotheosis&r can roll &eaffixes&r even on wooden gear — a &fCommon&r wooden sword may already outperform a bare iron one.
&7Break &fbushes&r and &floot bags&r to discover your first &daffixed weapons&r.
quest.minecraft:stone_sword.title: &8Stone Sword&r
quest.minecraft:stone_sword.quest_desc: Forge a &8Stone Sword&r and unlock the &aFrontier&r tier in &dApotheosis&r.
&eUncommon&r affixes now begin to drop — keep an eye out for &asuffixes like &dof Sharpness&r or &dof the Fox&r.
&aReforge&r unwanted gear at the &eReforging Table&r using &dGems&r and &fSigils&r.
quest.minecraft:iron_sword.title: &fIron Sword&r
quest.minecraft:iron_sword.quest_desc: Smelt &fIron Ingots&r and craft an &fIron Sword&r.
&5Rare&r affixes start to surface here — look for &aGem sockets&r and &elife-steal&r effects.
&7Slot a &dGem&r into your sword at a &eGem Cutting Table&r for permanent bonuses.
quest.minecraft:diamond_sword.title: &bDiamond Sword&r
quest.minecraft:diamond_sword.quest_desc: &6Epic&r and &dMythic&r affixes become possible — the gateway to truly powerful loadouts.
&aCombine&r a high-rarity sword with &eEnchantments&r and &dGems&r to dominate &cApotheosis bosses&r.
quest.minecraft:netherite_sword.title: &5Netherite Sword&r
quest.minecraft:netherite_sword.quest_de: Upgrade a &bDiamond Sword&r with a &eNetherite Ingot&r at a &7Smithing Table&r using the &dNetherite Upgrade Template&r.
&5Mythic&r and &cAncient&r affixes are now in reach — the top of the &dApotheosis&r gear ladder.
&7Netherite is &lfireproof&r and floats in lava — a safety net for late-game expeditions.
quest.apotheosis:boss_summoner.title: &cBoss Summoner&r
quest.apotheosis:boss_summoner.quest_des: The &cBoss Summoner&r spawns a random &dApotheosis Adventure Boss&r — the ultimate source of &6Mythic&r and &cAncient&r loot.
&cWarning&r: prepare your best gear — these encounters scale brutally.
quest.minecraft:bookshelf.title: &eBookshelf
quest.minecraft:bookshelf.quest_subtitle: The starting block of every enchanting room.
quest.minecraft:bookshelf.quest_desc: &7The &eBookshelf&7 is the cornerstone of any enchanting setup.

&7Each one placed within range of the &bEnchanting Table&7 contributes &b+1 Eterna&7 (max enchant level) and &b+0.75 Quanta&7. In Apothic Enchanting you can stack far more shelves than vanilla allows.
&eTip:&r Place 15 bookshelves in a 5×5 ring around the table to reach base Eterna 50.
quest.minecraft:trident.title: &bTrident
quest.minecraft:trident.quest_subtitle: A worthy test for your enchanting power.
quest.minecraft:trident.quest_desc: &7The &bTrident&7 is one of the most rewarding weapons to enchant in Apothic Enchanting.
&7With high enough &dArcana&7, you can roll &9Loyalty III&7, &bRiptide III&7, &eChanneling&7 and &cImpaling V&7 — plus rare Apoth-only enchants like &dCapturing&7 or &dKnowledge&7.
&eTip:&r Drowned with tridents are rare — try fishing during thunderstorms for a faster route.
quest.apothic_enchanting:endshelf.title: &dEndshelf
quest.apothic_enchanting:endshelf.quest_: &7The &dEndshelf&7 is a specialized bookshelf crafted from &dPurpur&7 and &dEnder Pearls&7.
&7Each one grants &b+2 Eterna&7 and a strong &d+5 Arcana&7 boost — making rare endgame enchants far more likely to appear in the table's offer list.
&eTip:&r Mix Endshelves with &cHellshelves&7 to balance Eterna, Quanta and Arcana.
Unlock loot-only enchantments at the table.
&7The &6Treasure Shelf&7 is the rarest shelf in Apothic Enchanting.
&7It allows your &bEnchanting Table&7 to offer normally &6treasure-only&7 enchantments such as &dMending&7, &dFrost Walker&7, &dSoul Speed&7 and &dSwift Sneak&7 directly.
&eTip:&r Combine 4+ Treasure Shelves with high Arcana to roll endgame books without trading with villagers.
quest.aquaculture:iron_fishing_rod.title: &fIron Fishing Rod&r
quest.aquaculture:iron_fishing_rod.quest: Craft the &fIron Fishing Rod&r — the entry point into &bAquaculture&r fishing.
&7Better &fdurability&r and &dcatch quality&r than the vanilla rod.
quest.aquaculture:gold_fishing_rod.title: &6Gold Fishing Rod&r
quest.aquaculture:gold_fishing_rod.quest: Upgrade to the &6Gold Fishing Rod&r — higher rare catch rates and improved &eluck&r.
&aPair with&r: &fBait&r (find from &7Worm Farms&r or by tilling dirt), &fHooks&r and &fLures&r in the &eTackle Box&r.
quest.ars_nouveau:worn_notebook.title: &eWorn Notebook
quest.ars_nouveau:worn_notebook.quest_su: Your first step into Ars Nouveau.
quest.ars_nouveau:worn_notebook.quest_de: &7The &eWorn Notebook&7 is the starting tome of every Ars Nouveau mage.
Craft it from a &6book&7 and a &fFeather&7. Right-click to open the &ein-game guide&7, listing every glyph, ritual, familiar, and machine.
&eUse it to unlock:&7 your first &dGlyphs&7 (Form / Effect / Augment) for spellcrafting.
&6Without this, no spells. Keep it on your hotbar.
quest.ars_nouveau:enchanting_apparatus.q: The heart of Ars Nouveau crafting.
&7The &dEnchanting Apparatus&7 transforms a central item using surrounding &eArcane Pedestals&7.
Place 1 to 8 pedestals around it, drop the recipe ingredients on each, place the main item on the apparatus, then right-click to craft.
&eUsed to craft:&7 Spellbooks, Wands, Magebloom gear, Glyph Press, Imbuement Chamber upgrades, and ritual cores.
&6Requires nearby Source&7 from a Source Jar or Source Relay.
quest.4F8119B6298EA753.title: &bRitual of the Cloudshaping
quest.4F8119B6298EA753.quest_subtitle: Bend the weather to your will.
quest.4F8119B6298EA753.quest_desc: &7Craft a &bRitual Tablet of the Cloudshaping&7 in the Enchanting Apparatus, place it on the ground, and activate it.
&eEffects:&7 toggles the current weather between clear, rain, and thunderstorm.
&eRequires:&7 nearby Source from a Source Jar to fuel the ritual.
&6Perfect for farmers, builders, or summoners who need a specific sky.
quest.0E88FDAE4CB5561B.title: &5Ritual of Awakening
quest.0E88FDAE4CB5561B.quest_subtitle: Give blocks a body and a soul.
quest.0E88FDAE4CB5561B.quest_desc: &7The &5Ritual of Awakening&7 transforms ordinary blocks into living constructs.
Place the ritual tablet near a stack of &eblocks&7 (logs, stones, etc.) and activate it. The blocks rise as a controllable golem-like entity.
&eUseful for:&7 mobile defense, decoration, or simply scaring fellow players.
&6Costs Source — keep a fueled Source Jar nearby.
quest.3EC8A0B89788D079.title: Flippers
quest.3EC8A0B89788D079.quest_desc: &bFlippers&r — Equip in the feet curio slot to gain a strong swim-speed boost underwater.
&eTip:&r Stack with Depth Strider boots for record-breaking ocean dives.
quest.2215FB0777D7029D.title: Steadfast Spikes
quest.2215FB0777D7029D.quest_desc: &dSteadfast Spikes&r — Curio boots that completely negate incoming knockback.
&7Essential against piglins, blazes, and Create cannons.&r
&eTip:&r Pair with a shield for an unmovable melee build.
quest.4A7AEBEB87CEC274.title: Running Shoes
quest.4A7AEBEB87CEC274.quest_desc: &bRunning Shoes&r — Boots curio that grants a permanent movement-speed bonus.
&7Hidden in dungeon chests across the Overworld.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with Soul Speed enchant for blistering nether travel.
quest.122E6E7CABCB17E7.title: Kitty Slippers
quest.122E6E7CABCB17E7.quest_desc: &bKitty Slippers&r — Boots curio that nullifies fall damage from short drops and silences footsteps.
&eTip:&r Pair with the Scarf of Invisibility for full ninja mode.
quest.5040B3D29F238BC0.title: Bunny Hoppers
quest.5040B3D29F238BC0.quest_desc: &bBunny Hoppers&r — Boots curio that grants a hefty jump-height boost.
&7Crafted by enchanted hares, or so the legend goes.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks well with the Helium Flamingo for vertical exploration.
quest.4D3379D38237F830.title: Aqua Dashers
quest.4D3379D38237F830.quest_desc: &dAqua Dashers&r — Boots curio granting massive underwater swim speed.
&eTip:&r Essential gear for raiding ocean monuments and Aquaculture loot.
quest.7188DC06A28AE30E.title: Golden Hook
quest.7188DC06A28AE30E.quest_desc: &6Golden Hook&r — Belt curio that lassos mobs and pulls them toward you on right-click.
&7Perfect for kidnapping villagers or yanking enemies off cliffs.&r
&eTip:&r Range scales with the entity's size and weight.
quest.73FC51144FC2DA52.title: Vampiric Glove
quest.73FC51144FC2DA52.quest_desc: &dVampiric Glove&r — Hand curio that heals you for a portion of melee damage dealt.
&eTip:&r Combine with high attack damage to maximize the heal per swing.
quest.3B3BD39BA02DCA13.title: Pocket Piston
quest.3B3BD39BA02DCA13.quest_desc: &dPocket Piston&r — Hand curio that boosts the knockback of every attack.
&7Send enemies flying without an enchanted weapon.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks with Knockback enchant for catapult-tier launches.
quest.427014BDE06DE631.title: Fire Gauntlet
quest.427014BDE06DE631.quest_desc: &6Fire Gauntlet&r — Hand curio that ignites enemies on every melee hit.
&7Acts like a permanent Fire Aspect, no enchant needed.&r
&eTip:&r Pair with Flame Pendant so you can dive into your own infernos safely.
quest.3705D303CF423804.title: Power Glove
quest.3705D303CF423804.quest_desc: &dPower Glove&r — Hand curio that adds flat attack damage to your melee strikes.
&7A simple, brutal upgrade for any fighter.&r
&eTip:&r Pairs perfectly with Feral Claws to multiply hits per second.
quest.6A452BFC8A967C39.title: Feral Claws
quest.6A452BFC8A967C39.quest_desc: &dFeral Claws&r — Hand curio that significantly increases attack speed.
&eTip:&r Best paired with Vampiric Glove for relentless lifesteal.
quest.3525D5DCC3A534D9.title: Digging Claws
quest.3525D5DCC3A534D9.quest_desc: &bDigging Claws&r — Hand curio that boosts tool mining speed against stone and earth.
&eTip:&r Stack with Efficiency V and Haste II for near-instant mining.
quest.589F1D502F680075.title: Helium Flamingo
quest.589F1D502F680075.quest_desc: &dHelium Flamingo&r — Necklace curio granting +30% jump height and 50% fall-damage reduction.
&7Hidden in dungeon loot — a true gem for explorers.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks with Feather Falling enchant for total air control.
quest.623796B1D7981E59.title: Crystal Heart
quest.623796B1D7981E59.quest_desc: &dCrystal Heart&r — Necklace curio granting bonus maximum health.
&7A heart of solid amethyst that pulses with vitality.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with Iron Heart and Resistance potions for true tank builds.
quest.1E40ACF3E69A4100.title: Antidote Vessel
quest.1E40ACF3E69A4100.quest_desc: &dAntidote Vessel&r — Belt curio that fully negates poison and wither effects.
&7Cave spiders, witches, and wither skeletons fear you.&r
&eTip:&r Mandatory equipment when raiding swamp huts and ancient cities.
quest.5EB7CE3A1DCD3E9B.title: Universal Attractor
quest.5EB7CE3A1DCD3E9B.quest_desc: &6Universal Attractor&r — Belt curio that pulls all dropped items within a wide radius toward you.
&7Never miss a drop again — ideal for mob farms and mining.&r
&eTip:&r Pair with the Pickaxe Heater for fully automated ore harvesting.
quest.4933CF4675E77D50.title: Obsidian Skull
quest.4933CF4675E77D50.quest_desc: &dObsidian Skull&r — Belt curio that prevents damage from magma blocks and hot terrain.
&eTip:&r Combine with Flame Pendant for total heat immunity.
quest.436E4E3515BCCDE9.title: Cloud in a Bottle
quest.436E4E3515BCCDE9.quest_desc: &6Cloud in a Bottle&r — Belt curio that grants an additional mid-air jump.
&eTip:&r Combine with Bunny Hoppers and Helium Flamingo for triple-vertical traversal.
quest.221C9EDA651144BA.title: Charm of Sinking
quest.221C9EDA651144BA.quest_desc: &bCharm of Sinking&r — Belt curio that lets you sink and walk normally underwater instead of floating up.
&eTip:&r Combine with the Snorkel for hands-free underwater breathing.
quest.3446803FB59D8875.title: Thorn Pendant
quest.3446803FB59D8875.quest_desc: &dThorn Pendant&r — Necklace curio that reflects a portion of melee damage back to attackers.
&7Passive defense — lets cooked mobs fight themselves.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks with the Thorns armor enchantment.
quest.27E951F4F4F6F847.title: Flame Pendant
quest.27E951F4F4F6F847.quest_desc: &6Flame Pendant&r — Necklace curio granting full immunity to fire and lava damage.
&7Better than any Fire Resistance potion — it never wears off.&r
&eTip:&r Essential before exploring the Nether or fighting Blazes.
quest.70C7D92844089DEB.title: Shock Pendant
quest.70C7D92844089DEB.quest_desc: &dShock Pendant&r — Necklace curio granting full immunity to lightning strikes.
&eTip:&r Lets you safely create Charged Creepers for mob-head farming.
quest.0E716B90E60C486B.title: Panic Necklace
quest.0E716B90E60C486B.quest_desc: &dPanic Necklace&r — Necklace curio that grants Speed when your health drops critically low.
&eTip:&r Combine with Cross Necklace for both regen and a getaway burst.
quest.72D6265E35814927.title: Cross Necklace
quest.72D6265E35814927.quest_desc: &dCross Necklace&r — Necklace curio that grants temporary invulnerability after taking heavy damage.
&7Buys you precious seconds to retreat or heal.&r
&eTip:&r Has an internal cooldown — don't rely on it back-to-back.
quest.7503823ACDDB0491.title: Lucky Scarf
quest.7503823ACDDB0491.quest_desc: &6Lucky Scarf&r — Necklace curio that grants a permanent Luck attribute bonus.
&7Better fishing, loot tables, and bounty rolls.&r
&eTip:&r Equip before opening dungeon chests for better drop chances.
quest.145E7D1A88B83DDD.title: Scarf of Invisibility
quest.145E7D1A88B83DDD.quest_desc: &6Scarf of Invisibility&r — Necklace curio that grants Invisibility when sneaking.
&7The ultimate stealth tool — no potion required.&r
&eTip:&r Equip leather armor or none at all to remain fully unseen.
quest.5F5E43B3F51CAE9E.title: Superstitious Hat
quest.5F5E43B3F51CAE9E.quest_desc: &dSuperstitious Hat&r — Head curio granting bonus Luck and improved drop chances.
&eTip:&r Stack with Lucky Scarf for absurdly favorable loot rolls.
quest.73B73870B29DFAD9.title: Villager Hat
quest.73B73870B29DFAD9.quest_desc: &bVillager Hat&r — Head curio that grants a discount on villager trades.
&7Cheaper emerald purchases and better deals overall.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with the Hero of the Village effect for record-low trade prices.
quest.2AD78E22988A92D3.title: Night Vision Goggles
quest.2AD78E22988A92D3.quest_desc: &dNight Vision Goggles&r — Head curio granting permanent Night Vision while worn.
&eTip:&r Especially useful in Deep Dark and modded dimensions where light is scarce.
quest.16255FB20F35A9D9.title: Snorkel
quest.16255FB20F35A9D9.quest_desc: &bSnorkel&r — Head curio that significantly extends underwater breathing time.
&eTip:&r Combine with Charm of Sinking and Aqua Dashers for the full diver kit.
quest.3E0643EA9183CDAE.title: Novelty Drinking Hat
quest.3E0643EA9183CDAE.quest_desc: &bNovelty Drinking Hat&r — Head curio that speeds up potion drinking and food consumption.
&7Chug potions in a heartbeat during combat.&r
&eTip:&r A lifesaver for emergency healing pots in PvP.
quest.2607F3DC07049785.title: Plastic Drinking Hat
quest.2607F3DC07049785.quest_desc: &dPlastic Drinking Hat&r — Head curio that restores hunger whenever you drink a potion.
&7Turn every potion into a snack break.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with brewing-heavy builds for endless food sustain.
quest.789AF6D0A6321945.title: Whoopee Cushion
quest.789AF6D0A6321945.quest_desc: &7Whoopee Cushion&r — A joke item with no real combat use, but unmatched comedic potential.
&7Place it down, wait for someone to step on it... pfffrt.&r
&eTip:&r Excellent for pranking unsuspecting teammates at base.
quest.161A90E134592D0E.title: Eternal Steak
quest.161A90E134592D0E.quest_desc: &6Eternal Steak&r — An infinite food item that never depletes after eating.
&7Solves hunger forever — one bite is all you need to own.&r
&eTip:&r Drop one in every shulker box, you'll never starve again.
quest.4564B577CB4EC046.title: Everlasting Beef
quest.4564B577CB4EC046.quest_desc: &6Everlasting Beef&r — A second infinite food item that never depletes.
&eTip:&r Functionally identical to Eternal Steak — collect both for the trophy.
quest.3E1A3BC8642390B3.title: Umbrella
quest.3E1A3BC8642390B3.quest_desc: &dUmbrella&r — Off-hand item that slows your fall when held and opened mid-air.
&7Mary Poppins style descent — no fall damage.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with Helium Flamingo for an ultra-safe parachute build.
quest.5CE44C58A470E48E.title: Slay the Mimic
quest.5CE44C58A470E48E.quest_desc: &6Mimic Hunter&r — Find and defeat an Artifacts &cMimic&r to complete this quest.
&7Mimics disguise themselves as ordinary chests in dungeons. Approach carefully — they bite hard.&r
&eTip:&r Kill them with melee to maximize artifact drop chance.
quest.79DF019CB23EC414.title: &5Enter the Otherside
quest.79DF019CB23EC414.quest_subtitle: Step through the gateway beyond the Deep Dark.
quest.79DF019CB23EC414.quest_desc: &7Activate a portal made of &3Reinforced Echo Shards&7 and step into the &5Otherside&7 dimension.
&7This twisted realm is a corrupted End — floating sculk islands, glowing geodes and ancient ruins, all watched over by the &cWarden's&7 echo.
&cWarning:&r Once you enter, &dShriekers&7 will activate faster. Carry &fWool boots&7 and never sprint.
quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.title: &5Otherside Survivor
quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.quest_subtitle: Spend real time inside the Otherside.
quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.quest_desc: &7Prove you can live and breathe in the &5Otherside&7 — not just visit it.
&7Set up a safe base, source food (sculk-tainted mobs drop edible meat), and farm &3Echo&7 and &3Sculk Crystals&7 for endgame gear.
&eTip:&r &dWarden Heart&7 grows here — protect it from despawning to harvest the &8Soul Elytra&7.
quest.5FFE4ACE65F45C83.title: &3Biomes of the Deep
quest.5FFE4ACE65F45C83.quest_desc: &7The &5Otherside&7 hides four distinct biomes — find them all to map the dimension.
&7Explore the &3Echoing Forest&7, the &8Blooming Caverns&7, the &5Otherside Vegetation&7 fields and the &fOvergrown Caverns&7. Each biome has unique flora, mobs and resources.
&eTip:&r Use a &6Compass of the Lost&7 to ping nearby unexplored biomes.
quest.064C54A1051A9C82.title: &dAncient Structure
quest.064C54A1051A9C82.quest_desc: &7Track down an &dAncient City Outpost&7 or &dOtherside Temple&7 hidden in the dimension.
&7These structures hold &6Echo Chests&7 with sculk-themed loot: &dSculk Catalyst Cores&7, ancient music discs and pre-enchanted Soul Tools.
&cWarning:&r Most structures spawn &dShriekers&7 — break them with &eSilk Touch&7 before scavenging.
quest.3C4ECF5741837953.title: &3Hunter: Drowned&r
quest.3C4ECF5741837953.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: Slay &eDrowned&r in rivers, oceans and ruined portals.
Drops include &fRotten Flesh&r, &bNautilus Shells&r and rarely &eTridents&r.
quest.599FA8D2FBA2725D.title: &3Hunter: Drowned Elite&r
quest.599FA8D2FBA2725D.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: Continue thinning the &eDrowned&r population — focus on &cTrident-wielders&r.
quest.4005DA1BA51C0C68.title: &fHunter: Ghast&r
quest.4005DA1BA51C0C68.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: Kill &fGhasts&r in the &cNether&r — particularly in the &7Nether Wastes&r and &8Soul Sand Valley&r.
Reflect their &cfireballs&r with a &fsword&r or &fpunch&r for an easy kill.
quest.0B6950F705B589CC.title: &6Hunter: Umvuthana&r
quest.0B6950F705B589CC.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: Hunt the &eUmvuthana&r tribe from &dMowzie's Mobs&r — found in &esavanna&r biomes around their totems.
&cBeware&r: they hunt in packs and call reinforcements from their &6Umvuthi Chieftain&r.
Drops &eUmvuthana Masks&r — wearable trophies with unique effects.
quest.47B80CE376D06676.title: &5Hunter: Troll&r
quest.47B80CE376D06676.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: Slay &dTrolls&r in the &5Twilight Forest&r — they roam &eHighland caves&r near &cTroll Caves&r structures.
&cTrolls hit hard&r and have heavy &fknockback resistance&r — bring &bDiamond&r or &5Netherite&r gear.
Drops &eMagic Beans&r used to grow giant beanstalks toward sky structures.
quest.minecraft:book.title: The Path of the Mage
quest.minecraft:book.quest_desc: &5Iron's Spells & Spellbooks&r — Welcome to the world of arcane magic.
Channel &dMana&r to cast spells from ten distinct schools: &cFire&r, &bIce&r, &fHoly&r, &2Nature&r, &eLightning&r, &5Ender&r, &4Blood&r, &dEvocation&r, &8Necromancy&r and the chaotic &6Eldritch&r.
Craft &7Inks&r, learn &eScrolls&r, and inscribe spells into &9Spellbooks&r to wield the elements at will.
&eTip:&r Complete this chapter to unlock powerful staves, unique armor sets, and rare spell rewards.
quest.7408CCF998D9CD37.title: Legendary Ink
quest.7408CCF998D9CD37.quest_desc: &6Legendary Ink&r — Required to scribe the most potent spells in existence.
Crafted from &6Legendary Ink Sacs&r dropped by the rarest casters or harvested from high-tier bosses. Only Legendary spells (level 9-10) demand this ink.
&eTip:&r Hoard sparingly — most builds only need a handful for endgame inscriptions.
quest.67A587F4BAD76C70.title: Common Ink
quest.67A587F4BAD76C70.quest_subtitle: The first step of every scribe.
quest.67A587F4BAD76C70.quest_desc: &fCommon Ink&r — The base reagent for inscribing &fCommon&r tier spells.
Crafted from &7Common Ink Sacs&r dropped by basic spellcasters such as &7Apprentice Mages&r and minor cultists. Used at the &9Inscription Table&r alongside a scroll and an empty spellbook slot.
&eTip:&r Keep a steady supply — early-game spells are cheap to learn and great for training Mana regen.
quest.6CE7115DA2B23776.title: Uncommon Ink
quest.6CE7115DA2B23776.quest_desc: &aUncommon Ink&r — Required to inscribe &aUncommon&r tier spells (level 3-4).
Refined from &aUncommon Ink Sacs&r dropped by &7Cryomancer&r minions, &cPyromancer&r acolytes, and other mid-tier casters.
&eTip:&r You'll need plenty of this ink when expanding into a second spell school.
quest.66762A4743104157.title: Rare Ink
quest.66762A4743104157.quest_desc: &9Rare Ink&r — Required to inscribe &9Rare&r tier spells (level 5-6).
Harvested from &9Rare Ink Sacs&r dropped by elite casters such as the &7Necromancer&r, &cPriest&r, or boss-tier mobs found in spellcaster strongholds.
&eTip:&r Rare spells include heavy hitters like &cFireball&r, &bIce Block&r and &fHealing Circle&r.
quest.4407BD7B5F033765.title: Epic Ink
quest.4407BD7B5F033765.quest_desc: &5Epic Ink&r — Required to inscribe &5Epic&r tier spells (level 7-8).
Extracted from &5Epic Ink Sacs&r dropped only by high-tier bosses such as the &cDead King&r, &dArchevoker&r and &7Citadel Keeper&r.
&eTip:&r Epic spells consume enormous Mana — pair them with a &dDiamond Spellbook&r or better.
quest.1CAEC4C273EDDB99.title: Rare Ink
quest.1CAEC4C273EDDB99.quest_desc: &9Rare Ink&r — A second supply for advanced inscription work.
Use this ink to scribe &9Rare&r tier spells across multiple schools, or stockpile it for spells that consume two or three inks per inscription.
&eTip:&r Some elite scrolls demand a mix of Rare and Epic ink — keep a balanced stash.
quest.4E3355FDCB65BB63.title: Epic Ink
quest.4E3355FDCB65BB63.quest_desc: &5Epic Ink&r — A second cache for elite inscription.
With multiple Epic Ink reserves you can scribe and re-scribe high-tier spells without farming bosses repeatedly.
&eTip:&r &dEvocation&r and &8Necromancy&r spells at Epic tier are some of the most devastating in the game.
quest.48C68664319B0294.title: Epic Ink
quest.48C68664319B0294.quest_desc: &5Epic Ink&r — A third cache for veteran spellscribes.
Use this ink stack to extend your library of &5Epic&r spells. Pair with high-rarity scrolls and a Diamond or Netherite Spellbook for best results.
&eTip:&r Some structures hide chests filled with pre-inked spell scrolls — explore mage towers and citadels.
quest.1A0368CB49B8CBFF.title: Epic Ink
quest.1A0368CB49B8CBFF.quest_desc: &5Epic Ink&r — A fourth supply for true masters.
At this point you should have access to most Epic-tier spell scrolls. Keep stockpiling to support multi-school builds.
&eTip:&r Combine schools wisely — &cFire&r + &eLightning&r overloads, &bIce&r + &fHoly&r purifies undead.
quest.73D6B980D35082A0.title: Epic Ink
quest.73D6B980D35082A0.quest_desc: &5Epic Ink&r — Another bundle for the scholarly mage.
True scholars maintain multiple stockpiles so they can re-roll spellbooks for optimal loadouts at any time.
&eTip:&r Use the &9Scroll Forge&r to combine duplicate scrolls into higher tiers.
quest.78AA7BFABBFB9973.title: Epic Ink
quest.78AA7BFABBFB9973.quest_desc: &5Epic Ink&r — One more reserve for runic experimentation.
Use this ink alongside &fBlank Runes&r to imbue spell-bearing runes that amplify specific schools.
&eTip:&r Slot empowered runes into your spellbook to permanently boost a school's damage or reduce its Mana cost.
quest.652A14E17DDE97E6.title: Legendary Ink
quest.652A14E17DDE97E6.quest_desc: &6Legendary Ink&r — Reserved for the most exquisite scrolls.
Use this rare reagent to scribe &6Legendary&r spells like &cRay of Siphoning&r, &bFrost Step&r mastery, or &5Void Tentacles&r — the ultimate expressions of each school.
&eTip:&r Legendary spells often have ten-second casts and ten-thousand Mana costs — gear accordingly.
quest.639531AB27DCD267.title: Blank Rune
quest.639531AB27DCD267.quest_subtitle: The base of all runic magic.
quest.639531AB27DCD267.quest_desc: &fBlank Rune&r — A featureless stone awaiting inscription.
Combine a Blank Rune with school-specific &7Arcane Essence&r at the &9Inscription Table&r to forge powerful runes that boost spell damage, cooldown, or Mana efficiency.
&eTip:&r Slot up to two runes into any spellbook for permanent passive bonuses.
quest.06F2C42E6408149E.title: Fire Arcane Essence
quest.06F2C42E6408149E.quest_subtitle: The spark of the flame mage.
quest.06F2C42E6408149E.quest_desc: Combine with a &fBlank Rune&r to craft a &cFire Rune&r, which increases &cFire&r spell power when slotted into a spellbook.
&eTip:&r Drops from &cPyromancers&r, magma cubes, and blazes in spellcaster lairs.
quest.489833A2A6C39151.title: Ice Arcane Essence
quest.489833A2A6C39151.quest_desc: &bIce Arcane Essence&r — A frigid shard of arcane cold.
Combine with a &fBlank Rune&r to craft an &bIce Rune&r, which increases &bIce&r spell power when slotted into a spellbook.
&eTip:&r Drops from &bCryomancers&r and ice spirits found in frozen biomes and ice citadels.
quest.19542103E042BDB5.title: Ender Arcane Essence
quest.19542103E042BDB5.quest_desc: &5Ender Arcane Essence&r — A shimmering fragment of dimensional energy.
Combine with a &fBlank Rune&r to craft an &5Ender Rune&r, which increases &5Ender&r spell power when slotted into a spellbook.
&eTip:&r Drops from endermen, shulkers, and the &5Citadel Keeper&r.
quest.24BAC1C0392E950E.title: Holy Arcane Essence
quest.24BAC1C0392E950E.quest_desc: &fHoly Arcane Essence&r — A radiant shard of divine power.
Combine with a &fBlank Rune&r to craft a &fHoly Rune&r, which increases &fHoly&r spell power when slotted into a spellbook.
&eTip:&r Drops from &fPriests&r and paladin-type mobs. Holy spells excel at smiting undead.
quest.5DE863C3FB6492BE.title: Blood Arcane Essence
quest.5DE863C3FB6492BE.quest_desc: &4Blood Arcane Essence&r — A crimson shard pulsing with life.
Combine with a &fBlank Rune&r to craft a &4Blood Rune&r, which increases &4Blood&r spell power when slotted into a spellbook.
&cWarning:&r Blood spells consume your HP as fuel. Pair with regeneration and lifesteal gear.
&eTip:&r Drops from necromancers and dark cultists.
quest.6D232F6D8E8DA546.title: Nature Arcane Essence
quest.6D232F6D8E8DA546.quest_desc: &2Nature Arcane Essence&r — A living seed of growth and renewal.
Combine with a &fBlank Rune&r to craft a &2Nature Rune&r, which increases &2Nature&r spell power when slotted into a spellbook.
&eTip:&r Drops from druids, witches, and creatures of the wild. Nature spells heal allies and entangle foes.
quest.mcwholidays:tall_gravestone.title: The Graveyard
quest.mcwholidays:tall_gravestone.quest_: &8The Graveyard&r — A cursed burial ground crawling with the restless dead.
Locate this structure to confront the &cDead King&r and gain access to powerful &8Necromancy&r reagents.
&eTip:&r Expect waves of zombies, skeletons, and wraiths. Bring &fHoly&r damage for an edge.
quest.knightquest:wither_helmet.title: Slay the Dead King
quest.knightquest:wither_helmet.quest_de: &8Dead King&r — A skeletal necromancer that commands the dead.
Defeat the &cDead King&r &71 time&r in the &8Graveyard&r to claim his crown and prove your mastery over death.
&cWarning:&r He summons endless minions and casts &8Ray of Siphoning&r. Keep moving.
&eTip:&r Drops &5Epic Ink&r, &8Necromancy&r scrolls, and the &6Dead King's Crown&r.
quest.minecraft:white_banner.title: The Lectern Hall
quest.minecraft:white_banner.quest_desc: &fLectern Hall&r — A grand library guarded by &dEvokers&r and their summoned vexes.
Locate this structure to confront the &dArchevoker&r and recover rare &dEvocation&r spells.
&eTip:&r The hall is filled with traps and illusionists. Bring sharp weapons and a good spellbook.
quest.irons_spellbooks:graybeard_staff.q: &dArchevoker&r — A wizened illager mage wielding the elder &dGraybeard Staff&r.
Defeat the &dArchevoker&r &71 time&r in the &fLectern Hall&r to seize his staff and his arcane secrets.
&cWarning:&r He summons vexes, fangs, and casts &dMagic Missile&r barrages. Use cover.
&eTip:&r Drops the &6Graybeard Staff&r — boosts Evocation power and grants &d+25% Mana Regen&r.
quest.twilightforest:hollow_vangrove_log: &2Apothecary Hut&r — A reclusive wooden shack brewing dangerous concoctions.
Locate this structure to confront the &aApothecarist&r and recover potion-based spell reagents.
&eTip:&r Watch out for thrown potions of weakness, poison, and harming.
quest.minecraft:splash_potion.title: Slay the Apothecarist
quest.minecraft:splash_potion.quest_desc: &aApothecarist&r — A potion-wielding witch-mage that hurls toxic brews.
Defeat the &aApothecarist&r &71 time&r at her hut to claim rare alchemy reagents.
&cWarning:&r Carry &fMilk Buckets&r to clear poison and weakness, and bring ranged damage.
&eTip:&r Drops &9Rare Ink&r, custom potions, and &2Nature&r school scrolls.
quest.irons_spellbooks:pyromancer_helmet: &cPyromancer's Den&r — A blazing lair carved into volcanic stone.
Locate this structure to confront the &cPyromancer&r and harvest &cFire&r-aligned loot.
&eTip:&r Drink a &cFire Resistance&r potion before entering — most of the floor is on fire.
quest.irons_spellbooks:pyrium_staff.ques: &cPyromancer&r — A fire-wreathed mage that unleashes infernos.
Defeat the &cPyromancer&r &71 time&r in his den to claim the legendary &6Pyrium Staff&r.
&cWarning:&r He casts &cFireball&r, &cWall of Fire&r, and summons &cMagma Cubes&r. Bring Fire Resistance.
&eTip:&r The &6Pyrium Staff&r massively boosts &cFire&r school spells and grants flame immunity to wielder.
quest.irons_spellbooks:cryomancer_helmet: &bCryomancer's Lair&r — A glacial fortress sculpted from eternal ice.
Locate this structure to confront the &bCryomancer&r and gather &bIce&r-aligned loot.
&eTip:&r Carry warm armor — frigid biome effects sap your stamina and slow your casts.
quest.irons_spellbooks:ice_staff.title: Slay the Cryomancer
quest.irons_spellbooks:ice_staff.quest_d: &bCryomancer&r — An ice-wielding sorcerer of overwhelming chill.
Defeat the &bCryomancer&r &71 time&r in his lair to claim the legendary &6Ice Staff&r.
&cWarning:&r He casts &bCone of Cold&r, &bFrost Step&r, and summons &bIce Spiders&r. Frost Resistance recommended.
&eTip:&r The &6Ice Staff&r boosts &bIce&r school spells and chills foes on melee hit.
quest.minecraft:deepslate_tiles.title: The Citadel of the Keeper
quest.minecraft:deepslate_tiles.quest_de: &8Keeper's Citadel&r — A vast deepslate stronghold of unknown origin.
Locate this structure to confront the &5Citadel Keeper&r — one of the most fearsome bosses in the modpack.
&eTip:&r The citadel is loaded with traps and elite guards. Bring backup and full Diamond or Netherite gear.
quest.irons_spellbooks:armor_pile.title: Slay the Citadel Keeper
quest.irons_spellbooks:armor_pile.quest_: &5Citadel Keeper&r — A multi-phase armored colossus animated by &5Ender&r magic.
Defeat the &5Citadel Keeper&r &71 time&r inside his citadel to seize his &7Armor Pile&r and the legendary &6Keeper Flamberge&r.
&cWarning:&r Three phases, summons armor minions, teleport strikes, and a devastating &5Ray of Siphoning&r in phase 3.
&eTip:&r Drops Epic Ink, the &6Keeper Flamberge&r, and unlocks the &dNetherite Mage Set&r recipe.
quest.irons_spellbooks:chain_creeper.que: &eChain Creeper&r — A creeper supercharged with arcane lightning.
On detonation, this hostile mob releases a chain of electrical strikes that arc between nearby targets — including allies.
&cWarning:&r Highly dangerous in groups — even a single chain can wipe a party.
&eTip:&r Drops &eLightning&r essence and rare reagents for the &6Lightning Rod&r staff.
quest.minecraft:bell.title: The Sanctuary
quest.minecraft:bell.quest_desc: &fSanctuary&r — A holy temple where the &fPriest&r conducts his rites.
Locate this structure to confront the &fPriest&r and gain &fHoly&r-school treasures.
&eTip:&r The Sanctuary buffs undead and curses living mages on entry. Cleanse with Holy spells.
quest.irons_spellbooks:priest_helmet.que: &fPriest&r — A zealous Holy spellcaster who heals undead minions and smites the living.
Defeat the &fPriest&r &71 time&r in the &fSanctuary&r to claim his helmet and the &fHoly&r school spell reagents.
&cWarning:&r He casts &fHealing Circle&r, &fGuiding Bolt&r, and summons skeleton paladins.
&eTip:&r Drops the &fPriest Helmet&r (Holy Power +30%) and rare Holy scrolls.
quest.minecraft:grass_block.title: The Overworld Realms
quest.minecraft:grass_block.quest_desc: &aOverworld&r — Most Iron's Spellbooks structures generate in the surface biomes.
Visit the &aOverworld&r dimension to locate Pyromancer dens, Cryomancer lairs, Sanctuaries, Apothecary Huts and more.
&eTip:&r Use the &9Lost Cities&r or &6Explorer's Compass&r to track down structures faster.
&8Necromancer&r — A skeletal spellcaster raising minions from corpses.
Defeat the &8Necromancer&r &71 time&r to claim the &8Tarnished Helmet&r and unlock the &8Necromancy&r school.
&cWarning:&r Constantly summons zombies and skeletons — kill them fast or they overwhelm you.
&eTip:&r Drops &9Rare Ink&r and the entrance to &8Necromancy&r spells.
quest.minecraft:sculk_sensor.title: The Deep Dark
quest.minecraft:sculk_sensor.quest_desc: &3Deep Dark Biome&r — A subterranean expanse of sculk and forgotten horrors.
Explore the &3Deep Dark&r biome to locate sources of &6Eldritch&r magic and rare reagents like &3Echo Shards&r.
&cWarning:&r The &3Warden&r patrols here. Stay silent or be obliterated.
&eTip:&r Eldritch spells use chaos energy — unpredictable but devastating.
quest.2664373E8977E7BE.title: Epic Ink
quest.2664373E8977E7BE.quest_desc: &5Epic Ink&r — A final reserve for elemental dominance.
By now, you should have access to all four schools of Epic spells. Use this last stockpile to round out your spellbook with cross-school synergies.
&eTip:&r Mix Epic Fire + Epic Ice for devastating thermal-shock combos.
quest.34FC02F47F52887F.title: Legendary Ink
quest.34FC02F47F52887F.quest_desc: &6Legendary Ink&r — The capstone reagent for the master archmage.
With Legendary Ink in hand you can scribe the &6Legendary&r tier spells: world-bending forces only the most disciplined casters can wield.
&eTip:&r Reserve Legendary spells for boss encounters — their Mana cost is colossal.
quest.irons_spellbooks:ice_spider_egg.qu: &bIce Spider Den&r — A frosted cave filled with arctic spiders and their eggs.
Locate this structure to harvest &bIce Spider Eggs&r — a key reagent for advanced &bIce&r spells and rune crafting.
&cWarning:&r The spiders bite with chilling venom that slows your casts.
&eTip:&r Eggs can be thrown to summon a temporary Ice Spider ally.
quest.deeperdarker:ice_lily.title: Ice Lily
quest.deeperdarker:ice_lily.quest_desc: &bIce Lily&r — A delicate frost-flower used as a reagent for &bIce&r spells.
Harvest this plant from frozen biomes or the &3Deep Dark&r to scribe powerful Ice scrolls and brew chill potions.
&eTip:&r Use shears for guaranteed drops, or break with hand for a chance.
quest.25F79B40579B3909.title: Keeper Flamberge
quest.25F79B40579B3909.quest_desc: &6Keeper Flamberge&r — A massive two-handed sword wielded by the &5Citadel Keeper&r.
This legendary weapon hits like a hammer and scales with &5Ender&r school power, granting bonus damage on every swing.
&eTip:&r Pair with an Ender-aligned spellbook to maximize melee + magic synergy.
quest.minecraft:polished_basalt.title: Volcanic Forge
quest.minecraft:polished_basalt.quest_de: &cVolcanic Forge&r — A basalt-built structure where &cPyromancers&r forge fire-bound relics.
Locate this structure to harvest unique &cFire&r reagents and the &6Pyrium Staff&r blueprint.
&eTip:&r Use Fire Resistance and bring water — lava channels run through every corridor.
quest.12498F8B5740F66E.title: Wizard Set
quest.12498F8B5740F66E.quest_desc: &5Wizard Set&r — A full set of robed magical armor.
Boosts &dMax Mana&r, &dSpell Power&r, and reduces casting time. The iconic outfit of any aspiring archmage.
&eTip:&r Combine all four pieces (Hat, Robes, Pants, Boots) to unlock the &5Set Bonus: -10% Mana Cost&r.
quest.29605960803BE885.title: Echoing Strikes
quest.29605960803BE885.quest_desc: &3Echoing Strikes&r — A unique spell or weapon enchantment that resonates with the &3Deep Dark&r.
Each hit echoes back, dealing additional &3Eldritch&r damage that ignores armor and amplifies with sound.
&eTip:&r Synergizes with &3Echo Shards&r and Warden-themed gear.
quest.1338EED4F26F3EFF.title: Counterspell
quest.1338EED4F26F3EFF.quest_desc: &5Counterspell&r — An &dEvocation&r school spell that interrupts and silences an enemy mid-cast.
Cast on a charging mage to cancel their spell entirely and impose a 5-second silence debuff. Essential against boss casters.
&eTip:&r Drop the boss before their ult lands — Counterspell is your safety net.
quest.161477ABCC437BD2.title: Frostbite
quest.161477ABCC437BD2.quest_subtitle: Pierce the cold to the bone.
quest.161477ABCC437BD2.quest_desc: &bFrostbite&r — An &bIce&r school spell inflicting deep, lingering chill.
Targets take damage over time and have their movement and attack speed reduced. Stacks with other freeze effects.
&eTip:&r Combine with &bCone of Cold&r for a brutal slow-and-shatter combo.
quest.6046CA1F6AFE2AEA.title: Blood Staff
quest.6046CA1F6AFE2AEA.quest_desc: &4Blood Staff&r — A crimson focus that empowers &4Blood&r school spells.
Reduces the HP cost of Blood spells and grants lifesteal on direct hits. Wielders trade vitality for devastating offense.
&cWarning:&r Blood magic scales with missing HP — risky but rewarding.
quest.08767A1E6D48A5EA.title: Graybeard Staff
quest.08767A1E6D48A5EA.quest_desc: &6Graybeard Staff&r — A relic looted from the slain &dArchevoker&r.
Massively boosts &dEvocation&r school damage and grants &d+25% Mana Regen&r passively.
&eTip:&r The best support staff for any group caster build.
quest.794D6F9B8DB31E7D.title: Ice Staff
quest.794D6F9B8DB31E7D.quest_desc: &6Ice Staff&r — A glacial focus pried from the dead hands of the &bCryomancer&r.
Boosts &bIce&r school spell power and chills foes hit by melee swings. Wielders gain partial cold immunity.
&eTip:&r Pair with &bFrost Step&r for unrivaled mobility.
quest.67439337E29A308B.title: Artificer Cane
quest.67439337E29A308B.quest_desc: &dArtificer Cane&r — A versatile rod that empowers all schools modestly.
Provides a small flat bonus to every spell school's damage. Ideal for hybrid builds and early-game mages.
&eTip:&r Easier to craft than school-specific staves and great for beginners.
quest.0F8B349EBC9110D6.title: Lightning Rod
quest.0F8B349EBC9110D6.quest_desc: &eLightning Rod&r — An electrically charged staff for &eLightning&r school casters.
Increases lightning spell damage and grants &d+1% Lightning Power&r per level of charge. Attracts strikes during storms for bonus damage.
&eTip:&r Wear rubber or insulating gear if you don't want to fry yourself.
quest.29BDCF3C1B11B4C6.title: Pyrium Staff
quest.29BDCF3C1B11B4C6.quest_desc: &6Pyrium Staff&r — A staff forged in volcanic fire and looted from the &cPyromancer&r.
Massively boosts &cFire&r school spells and grants permanent fire immunity to the wielder.
&eTip:&r The ultimate weapon for any fire-focused mage build.
quest.67308C5DDF4A10D2.title: Wandering Magician Set
quest.67308C5DDF4A10D2.quest_desc: &aWandering Magician Set&r — Light armor for the nomadic mage.
Provides movement speed, reduced Mana cost on movement spells, and modest spell power. Designed for hit-and-run casters.
&eTip:&r Pair with &5Ender&r school spells like &5Frost Step&r or &5Blink&r for kiting builds.
quest.19B057DFF331E41C.title: Pumpkin Armor
quest.19B057DFF331E41C.quest_desc: &6Pumpkin Armor&r — A novelty armor set with surprising magical properties.
Grants minor &8Necromancy&r resistance and immunity to enderman aggression (the helmet acts as a pumpkin).
&eTip:&r Wear during Halloween events for a special tooltip and rumored hidden bonus.
quest.00D80AA4CDD8335C.title: Paladin Chestplate
quest.00D80AA4CDD8335C.quest_desc: Boosts &fHoly&r school spell power, grants damage reduction vs. undead, and slowly regenerates Mana while in sunlight.
&eTip:&r The signature piece of any Holy-Magic hybrid tank build.
quest.44E8D5DAD7E22724.title: Netherite Mage Set
quest.44E8D5DAD7E22724.quest_desc: &8Netherite Mage Set&r — The ultimate magical armor.
Combines netherite-tier protection with the spellpower of robed gear: massive Max Mana, +35% spell damage, and -15% casting time. Fire-immune and knockback-resistant.
&eTip:&r Crafted by upgrading the &dDiamond Mage Set&r with Netherite Ingots at a Smithing Table — requires Citadel Keeper loot.
quest.258B4890CF13D199.title: Magehunter
quest.258B4890CF13D199.quest_subtitle: A weapon forged to slay casters.
quest.258B4890CF13D199.quest_desc: &cMagehunter&r — A sword purpose-built to dismantle spellcasters.
Deals bonus damage to entities with high Mana pools, drains their Mana on hit, and silences them for 2 seconds per strike.
&eTip:&r Essential gear for PvP and boss-mage encounters.
quest.mekanism:creative_energy_cube.ques: Infinite energy. End of the line.
&6You did it.&r You climbed every tier of Mekanism and reached the &6Creative Energy Cube&7 — an unlimited source of Forge Energy.
&7This block outputs as much FE as any machine can consume, on every side. There is no recipe: it is a symbolic reward for completing the full Mekanism tree.
&eTip:&r From here, scale up — build factories, MekaSuit modules, and the Fusion Reactor without worrying about power again.
quest.mekanism:basic_control_circuit.que: Tier 1 — the foundation of every Mekanism machine.
&7The &aBasic Control Circuit&7 is the entry-level brain of all Mekanism machinery.
&7Craft it from &eOsmium Ingots&7 and &fRedstone&7 in the &bMetallurgic Infuser&7. Required for the &aEnrichment Chamber&7, &aCrusher&7, &aEnergized Smelter&7 and every Tier 1 upgrade.
&eTip:&r Stockpile these early — you will need dozens before reaching Tier 2.
Tier 2 — refined logic for serious automation.
&7The &9Advanced Control Circuit&7 unlocks the second tier of Mekanism technology.
&7Built from a Basic Circuit infused with &eOsmium&7 and processed with &bRedstone&7, it powers the &9Purification Chamber&7, &9Osmium Compressor&7 and ×3 ore tripling.
&eTip:&r Tier 2 is where ore doubling becomes tripling — a massive yield jump.
quest.mekanism:elite_control_circuit.que: &7The &5Elite Control Circuit&7 represents the third tier of Mekanism machinery.
&7Required for the &5Chemical Injection Chamber&7, &5Pressurized Reaction Chamber&7 and ×4 ore quadrupling. Demands &dRefined Glowstone&7 and Advanced Circuits.
&eTip:&r At this tier you also unlock Elite Factories — automate batch processing of 9 stacks at once.
&7The &dUltimate Control Circuit&7 is the pinnacle of Mekanism crafting.
&7Forged from &dRefined Obsidian&7 and Elite Circuits, it unlocks the &dDigital Miner&7, &dQIO Storage&7, the full &6MekaSuit&7, the &cFusion Reactor&7 and ×5 ore quintupling.
&eTip:&r Reaching this tier effectively ends scarcity — plan your factory's logistics before mass-producing.
quest.mekanism:chemical_oxidizer.title: &bChemical Oxidizer&r
quest.mekanism:chemical_oxidizer.quest_d: The &bChemical Oxidizer&r converts solid materials into &agases&r — a critical step for &eMekanism&r chemistry chains.
&7Required for &cFission&r and &dFusion Reactor&r fuel production lines — feeds into &eUranium Hexafluoride&r and &dDeuterium-Tritium&r pipelines.
quest.2000000000000020.title: &dCity Hunter
quest.2000000000000020.quest_desc: &7Beyond the central island and across the void lie the &dEnd Cities&7 — purple towers built by long-vanished beings.
&eHow to find one:&7 take an Ender Pearl or boat across the void after killing the Ender Dragon, or use a &6Map of the End&7.
&eInside you will find:&7 Shulkers, diamond gear, enchanted books, and the prized &fElytra&7 aboard an End Ship.
&aBring projectiles — Shulkers float and hit hard.
quest.2000000000000022.title: &fSky's the Limit
quest.2000000000000022.quest_subtitle: &7Claim the Elytra and rule the air.&r
quest.2000000000000022.quest_desc: &7The &fElytra&7 is found on the End Ship, in an item frame above the boat.
Equip it in the chestplate slot, then jump from a height and hold &eSpace&7 to glide.
&eBoost with Firework Rockets&7 for forward thrust. Combine with &6Unbreaking III&7 and &dMending&7 for longevity.
&aTrue endgame mobility — no fall damage, infinite vistas.
quest.2000000000000030.title: &dAlien Food
quest.2000000000000030.quest_desc: &7&dChorus Fruit&7 grows on the outer End islands atop tall purple stalks.
Break the &etop blocks first&7 — the plant collapses, dropping every chorus fruit it carried.
&eEat it&7 to teleport a few blocks at random — handy escape tool.
&eCook it&7 into &6Popped Chorus Fruit&7 to craft &dPurpur Blocks&7 and &fEnd Rods&7.
quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &5Summoning Rituals
Call forth spirits from the Otherworld.
&7Summoning rituals bind &5spirits&7 from the Otherworld into our realm.
Draw the correct &epentacle&7 with chalk, place the &6Golden Sacrificial Bowl&7 in the center, add the required ingredients, and trigger the ritual.
&eTier matters:&7 Foliot, Djinni, Afrit, and finally Marid require increasingly rare chalks and components.
&6Consult the Dictionary of Spirits&7 to learn each ritual's recipe.
quest.occultism:chalk_red_impure.title: &cImpure Red Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_red_impure.quest_s: Bind the spark of Djinn into chalk form.
quest.occultism:chalk_red_impure.quest_d: &7Red chalk is the &csecond-tier&7 ritual chalk, used to summon and bind &cDjinni&7 spirits.
Craft it by performing the appropriate &eDjinni ritual&7 on a piece of &fwhite chalk&7 with the required catalysts.
&eUsed for:&7 advanced summoning pentacles, crafting rituals, and unlocking the path to &6Marid&7 magic.
quest.occultism:dimensional_mineshaft.qu: &7The &5Dimensional Mineshaft&7 lets a bound &6Foliot Miner&7 dig endlessly in the Otherworld and bring ores back to you.
&ePlace a Miner Spirit&7 (crafted via ritual) inside the mineshaft along with fuel.
Different miner tiers yield different resources: &7stone, &firon, &6gold, &bdiamond, &cnetherite&7, and beyond.
&aA fully automated, infinite ore farm. Use it well.
quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &6Crafting Rituals
Forge items only spirits can shape.
&7Crafting rituals call upon spirits to assemble items beyond mortal hands.
Draw the matching &epentacle&7, place the &6Golden Sacrificial Bowl&7 in the center, and toss the required ingredients on the ground around it.
&eExamples:&7 Storage Stabilizers, Familiar Rings, Demonic Crystals, and the Storage Controller core.
&6See the Dictionary of Spirits&7 for the exact pentacle and ingredient list.
quest.occultism:chalk_lime_impure.title: &aImpure Lime Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_lime_impure.quest_: &7Lime chalk is used in select &asummoning pentacles&7 to bind nature-aligned Foliots.
Craft it by completing the &elime chalk ritual&7 in the Dictionary of Spirits.
&eRequired for:&7 advanced familiar and animal-affinity rituals.
quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &5Possession Rituals
Bind a spirit inside a living vessel.
&7Possession rituals force a spirit into a hostile mob, transforming it into a useful drop machine.
&eExamples:&7 possessed Endermite (Endermen Essence), possessed Skeleton, possessed Ghast.
Draw the pentacle, place a &eGolden Sacrificial Bowl&7, drop in the catalyst, then trigger the ritual near the target mob.
&6One of the only reliable ways to farm rare boss-tier drops.
quest.occultism:chalk_orange_impure.ques: Mid-tier chalk for fire and travel rituals.
&7Orange chalk is used in pentacles related to &6fire-aligned Djinni&7 and travel magic.
Craft it via the matching &eDjinni crafting ritual&7 in the Dictionary of Spirits.
&eUsed for:&7 transportation, fast-travel, and Foliot/Djinni hybrid pentacles.
quest.occultism:chalk_gray_impure.title: &8Impure Gray Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_gray_impure.quest_: &7Gray chalk fills the auxiliary marks of many pentacles.
Craft it via the &egray chalk ritual&7. Cheap to produce and used in bulk.
&eAlways keep a stack on hand&7 before attempting any high-tier summoning.
quest.occultism:chalk_green_impure.title: &2Impure Green Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_green_impure.quest: Chalk woven with growth and life.
&7Green chalk is required by &2nature&7 and &agrowth&7 themed rituals.
Crafted from a Djinni-tier ritual. Pairs well with lime chalk in advanced pentacles.
&eRequired for:&7 select familiar bindings and farming-aid rituals.
quest.occultism:chalk_black_impure.title: &0Impure Black Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_black_impure.quest: &7Black chalk is the &8third-tier&7 ritual chalk, bound to powerful &cAfrit&7 spirits.
Craft it through a multi-step &eAfrit ritual&7 requiring red and white chalks already on hand.
&eUnlocks:&7 Afrit Essence rituals, high-tier crafting pentacles, and the road to &dMarid&7.
quest.occultism:chalk_pink_impure.title: &dImpure Pink Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_pink_impure.quest_: Chalk used in familiar and bond rituals.
&7Pink chalk decorates pentacles that &dbind familiars&7 (cats, beholders, dragons, bats, etc.) to the summoner.
Craft it via the &epink chalk ritual&7 in the Dictionary of Spirits.
&eFamiliars&7 grant passive buffs and help in combat. Worth the chalk.
quest.occultism:chalk_blue_impure.title: &9Impure Blue Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_blue_impure.quest_: &7Blue chalk is the &9fourth and highest-tier&7 ritual chalk, used only for &9Marid&7 summoning.
Requires a chain of &eAfrit-tier rituals&7 to produce.
&eUnlocks:&7 the strongest Occultism crafting recipes, including the &6Storage Controller&7 ecosystem.
Chalk for water and storage rituals.
&7Light blue chalk is found in pentacles linked to &bdimensional storage&7 and water-aligned spirits.
Craft it via the matching ritual. Pairs with white and blue chalk in late-game pentacles.
&eEssential&7 for completing the Storage Controller crafting chain.
quest.occultism:chalk_magenta_impure.que: &7Magenta chalk appears in &dpossession&7 and transformation pentacles.
Craft it through its dedicated &eDjinni ritual&7.
&eUsed for:&7 binding spirits into mobs to harvest rare drops.
quest.occultism:chalk_cyan_impure.title: &3Impure Cyan Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_cyan_impure.quest_: &7Cyan chalk is used in pentacles tied to the &3Otherworld dimension&7 and its inhabitants.
Craft it via the corresponding ritual once you have access to higher-tier chalks.
quest.occultism:chalk_brown_impure.title: &6Impure Brown Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_brown_impure.quest: Chalk grounded in earth and stone.
&7Brown chalk fills support marks in many earth-themed pentacles.
Craft it through its &eFoliot-tier ritual&7 once basic chalks are available.
&eFrequently paired&7 with gray chalk for utility rituals.
quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &eMiscellaneous Rituals
Utility rituals for everyday occultists.
&7Not every ritual summons a spirit or crafts an item. Some simply &etwist the world around you&7.
&eExamples:&7 weather control, time skip, mob clearing, dimension travel, repair effects.
&6Open the Dictionary of Spirits&7 and browse the &eMiscellaneous Rituals&7 page to see what's possible.
&aOften cheaper than their crafting equivalents and great for quality-of-life.
quest.minecraft:spawner.title: Chapter: Apothic Spawners
quest.minecraft:spawner.quest_subtitle: Capture, modify and weaponize monster spawners.
quest.minecraft:spawner.quest_desc: &7Open the &eApothic Spawners&7 chapter to master the secret art of taming spawners.
&7Learn how to use the &bSilk Spell&7 to harvest spawners, swap their entity with &eSpawn Eggs&7, and upgrade them with modifier items to boost spawn rate, range and player checks.
&eTip:&r Most hostile mobs are blacklisted server-side. Check the wiki before farming.
quest.minecraft:enchanting_table.title: Chapter: Apothic Enchanting
quest.minecraft:enchanting_table.quest_d: &7Open the &eApothic Enchanting&7 chapter to unlock the deepest enchantments in Arcadia.
&7Build a true power-room with custom shelves (&cHellshelf&7, &5Soulshelf&7, &dEndshelf&7, &6Treasure Shelf&7) to raise &bEterna&7, &dArcana&7 and &eQuanta&7.
&eTip:&r Place a &6Statue of the Mage&7 to reroll your top enchant for free.
quest.aquaculture:diamond_fishing_rod.qu: Master rivers, oceans and rare catches.
&7Open the &bAquaculture&7 chapter to turn fishing into a real progression branch.
&7Craft better rods (wooden -> diamond -> neptunium), use specialized &eBait&7, and catch dozens of new fish species, hidden loot crates and even legendary tridents.
&eTip:&r Fish in biome-specific waters at night for the rarest drops.
quest.immersiveengineering:hammer.title: Chapter: Immersive Engineering
quest.immersiveengineering:hammer.quest_: &7Open the &6Immersive Engineering&7 chapter to build classic 1900s-style factories.
&7Use the &eEngineer's Hammer&7 to rotate machines, connect &bwire connectors&7 with copper/steel wires, and power multiblocks like the &cBlast Furnace&7, &eExcavator&7 and &6Arc Furnace&7.
&eTip:&r The Engineer's Manual is your best friend — keep it on your hotbar.
quest.minecraft:netherrack.title: Chapter: The Nether
quest.minecraft:netherrack.quest_subtitl: Burn, dig and survive the red dimension.
quest.minecraft:netherrack.quest_desc: &7Open the &cNether&7 chapter to track every milestone of the burning realm.
&7Light a portal, hunt &eBlazes&7, harvest &6Ancient Debris&7, trade with &dPiglins&7 and defeat the &cWither&7. Many late-game recipes need Nether-only ingredients.
&eTip:&r Bring &bFire Resistance&7 potions and gold armor before stepping in.
quest.minecraft:crafting_table.title: Chapter: Getting Started
quest.minecraft:crafting_table.quest_sub: Your first steps in Arcadia V2.
quest.minecraft:crafting_table.quest_des: &7Open the &eGetting Started&7 chapter to learn the basics of the modpack.
&7Punch wood, craft a workbench, build a shelter, eat food and survive the first night. This chapter holds your hand through every essential vanilla step.
&eTip:&r Read the &6Arcadia Welcome Book&7 from your spawn inventory first.
quest.create:wrench.title: Chapter: Create
quest.create:wrench.quest_desc: &7Open the &6Create&7 chapter to master the kinetic engineering mod.
&7Build &eWater Wheels&7, &bWindmills&7 and &cSteam Engines&7 to generate Stress Units, then power &eMechanical Crafters&7, &dPresses&7 and full assembly lines.
&eTip:&r Use the &6Wrench&7 to rotate, dismantle and reconfigure any Create block.
quest.mekanism:configurator.title: Chapter: Mekanism
quest.mekanism:configurator.quest_subtit: Industrial tech, ore tripling and MekaSuit.
quest.mekanism:configurator.quest_desc: &7Open the &bMekanism&7 chapter for the full industrial-tech progression.
&7Climb the tier ladder &eBasic -> Advanced -> Elite -> Ultimate&7, multiply your ore output up to ×5, automate with Factories, and build the legendary &6MekaSuit&7.
&eTip:&r The &eConfigurator&7 sets every machine's I/O sides in seconds.
quest.irons_spellbooks:scroll.title: Chapter: Iron's Spells & Spellbooks
quest.irons_spellbooks:scroll.quest_desc: &7Open the &dIron's Spellbooks&7 chapter to walk the path of magic.
&7Learn spells from &eScrolls&7, bind them into &bSpellbooks&7, and specialize in &cFire&7, &bIce&7, &fHoly&7, &5Eldritch&7, &2Nature&7 or &8Blood&7 schools.
&eTip:&r Each spell school has its own armor set giving +tier and -cooldown.
quest.aether:aether_portal_frame.title: Chapter: The Aether
quest.aether:aether_portal_frame.quest_s: Soar through the floating sky dimension.
quest.aether:aether_portal_frame.quest_d: &7Open the &bAether&7 chapter to explore the legendary heavenly dimension.
&7Build a &eGlowstone&7 frame, douse it with &9Water&7, and discover floating islands, &dValkyries&7, &6Bronze Dungeons&7 and the precious &eGravitite&7 ore.
&eTip:&r Falling out of the Aether throws you back to the Overworld — bring a &fCloud Parachute&7.
quest.deeperdarker:heart_of_the_deep.que: &7Open the &8Deeper & Darker&7 chapter to brave the Otherside.
&7Survive &3Sculk&7 biomes, awaken the &cWarden&7, harvest &bEcho&7 and &3Sculk Crystals&7, and craft the dreaded &8Soul Elytra&7.
&cWarning:&r The Warden is a one-shot threat — sneak, no sprint, no projectile noise.
quest.minecraft:end_portal_frame.title: Chapter: The End
quest.minecraft:end_portal_frame.quest_s: Slay the Dragon, then keep going.
quest.minecraft:end_portal_frame.quest_d: &7Open the &5End&7 chapter for the late-game dragon arc.
&7Find the Stronghold, defeat the &dEnder Dragon&7, harvest &dEnd Cities&7, loot &dElytras&7 and tame &5Shulkers&7. Many magic mods need End-only ingredients.
&eTip:&r Bring beds for the dragon — they still hold the highest DPS in vanilla.
quest.mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor: &7Open the &aNuclear&7 chapter to build Mekanism's endgame power plants.
&7Enrich uranium, assemble a &cFission Reactor&7, cool it with sodium, then chain a &bTurbine&7 and a &6Fusion Reactor&7 for millions of FE/t.
&cWarning:&r A meltdown will irradiate your entire base — always plan a coolant loop.
quest.fluxnetworks:flux_core.title: Chapter: Flux Networks
quest.fluxnetworks:flux_core.quest_desc: &7Open the &eFlux Networks&7 chapter to ditch cables forever.
&7Craft a &6Flux Plug&7 on your generators and a &bFlux Point&7 on your machines, link them to the same network, and watch energy teleport across worlds.
&eTip:&r The &dFlux Controller&7 raises transfer limits and lets you bridge dimensions.
quest.immersive_aircraft:gyrodyne.title: Chapter: Immersive Aircraft
quest.immersive_aircraft:gyrodyne.quest_: &7Open the &bImmersive Aircraft&7 chapter to build personal flying machines.
&7Assemble &eBiplanes&7, &6Gyrodynes&7, &dQuadrocopters&7 and majestic &fAirships&7 — each with its own fuel, speed and cargo capacity.
&eTip:&r Aircraft can be parked, locked and even &eboarded&7 by your friends.
quest.artifacts:mimic_spawn_egg.title: Chapter: Artifacts & Loot
quest.artifacts:mimic_spawn_egg.quest_su: Curiosity items hidden in the world.
quest.artifacts:mimic_spawn_egg.quest_de: &7Open the &dArtifacts&7 chapter to hunt powerful curio trinkets.
&7Each &6Artifact&7 is a passive accessory: belts, gloves, necklaces, charms... obtained from dungeon chests or by killing the dreaded &cMimic&7.
&eTip:&r Equip artifacts in the &bCurios&7 slots (press &eC&7 to open the menu).
quest.occultism:spirit_fire.title: Chapter: Occultism
quest.occultism:spirit_fire.quest_desc: &7Open the &5Occultism&7 chapter to summon entities from the spirit realm.
&7Light &dSpirit Fire&7, draw chalk pentagrams, perform &cRituals&7 to summon &eDjinns&7, &5Foliots&7 and &8Afrits&7, and bind them as familiars or workers.
&eTip:&r Spirits can store storage, mine ores, craft items, even brew potions for you.
quest.simplyswords:tampered_remnant.ques: &7Open the &6Simply Swords&7 chapter to craft exotic blades.
&7Discover &eKatanas&7, &dGreatswords&7, &bRapiers&7, &cClaymores&7 and &fScythes&7 — each with unique stamina-based special attacks bound to &eAlt&7.
&eTip:&r The &6Empowered Remnant&7 is the legendary endgame material — only drops from special bosses.
quest.refinedstorage:creative_controller: The &dCreative Controller&r is the heart of an unlimited &bRefined Storage&r network — no &eFE&r consumption, ever.
Connect &7Cables&r, &eImporters&r, &eExporters&r and &eDisk Drives&r to build your digital storage system.
&aOne controller&r is enough to power an entire base — no need for &cPower Cells&r or &eRF generators&r.
quest.refinedstorage:creative_wireless_g: Access your &bRefined Storage&r network from &eanywhere&r in the dimension — no &7Wireless Transmitter&r required.
&aRight-click&r the grid to open the network browser remotely.
&7Unlimited battery, unlimited range — the ultimate convenience tool.
quest.refinedstorage:creative_wireless_a: Monitor every &eautocrafting&r job in your &bRefined Storage&r network — remotely and without power cost.
&aCancel&r or &erestart&r tasks on the fly without returning to your base.
quest.refinedstorage_quartz_arsenal:crea: &7A full crafting table in your pocket.&r
Combine a &eWireless Grid&r with a &fCrafting Table&r — craft from your network anywhere.
&aFrom &dQuartz Arsenal&r addon — unlimited energy and range.
&7No more running back home for one &fStick&r.
quest.refinedstorage:creative_portable_g: A standalone grid with its own &eStorage Disk slot&r — works without a network.
&aRight-click&r a &7Disk Drive&r to sync, then take your inventory mining with you.
&7Creative version&r: no battery drain, infinite uses.
quest.267C22F01CBAD504.title: &6Empowered Remnant
quest.267C22F01CBAD504.quest_subtitle: The legendary core of Simply Swords endgame.
quest.267C22F01CBAD504.quest_desc: &6The Empowered Remnant&r is the highest-grade smithing material in Simply Swords.
&7Obtained by combining several &eTampered Remnants&7 dropped by elite mobs, then re-forged in a smithing setup, it unlocks the crafting of &6Soulkeeper&7, &cSoulrender&7 and &dChampion&7 weapons.
&eTip:&r Pair this material with a high-arcana enchant from Apothic to push DPS to legendary tiers.
&cWarning:&r Each Empowered Remnant takes hours of farming — focus on Ancient City and Stronghold dungeons for the fastest drops.
quest.6000000000000002.title: &eThe Brass Typhoon
quest.6000000000000002.quest_subtitle: &7Conquer the brass dungeon of the Sun Spirit.&r
quest.6000000000000002.quest_desc: &7High in the Aether, the &eBronze Dungeon&7 hangs in the sky — a fortress of &6brass&7 and &ecarved stone&7 guarded by the &cSun Spirit&7.
&eHow to enter:&7 find the locked dungeon, defeat the lower bosses (Slider, Valkyrie Queen) to obtain the keys, then break the central seal.
&eInside you will face:&7 the &6Sun Spirit&7, a flame-wreathed boss vulnerable only to &bIce Crystals&7.
&aReward:&7 Sun Spirit Trophy, Phoenix Bow, and a permanent day-night cycle reset for the Aether.
quest.minecraft:nether_star.title: &5Wither Star&r
quest.minecraft:nether_star.quest_desc: The &5Wither Star&r drops from the &cWither&r, summoned by placing 4 &8Soul Sand&r in a T-shape and topping it with 3 &fWither Skeleton Skulls&r.
&eHunt&r &8Wither Skeletons&r in &cNether Fortresses&r to collect the skulls.
&7Used to craft a &bBeacon&r, granting permanent buffs to your base.&r
quest.5FCA7209EF8CB54B.title: &aFungal Woods&r
quest.5FCA7209EF8CB54B.quest_desc: Explore the &cCrimson&r and &dWarped&r forests of the Nether.
Harvest &cCrimson&r and &dWarped&r stems for &6building&r, and gather &eShroomlights&r for decorative lighting.
&7Tip: &fHoglins&r flee from &dWarped Fungi&r, and &cPiglins&r are hostile in the &dWarped Forest&r.
quest.1000000000000028.title: &8Dark Rocks&r
quest.1000000000000028.quest_desc: Mine &8Basalt&r, &cBlackstone&r and &8Gilded Blackstone&r from the &eBasalt Deltas&r and &eBastions&r.
These &7dark stones&r are the backbone of every Nether fortress aesthetic.
&aGilded Blackstone&r has a chance to drop &6Gold Nuggets&r when broken without &bSilk Touch&r.
quest.1000000000000031.title: &6Shiny Things&r
quest.1000000000000031.quest_desc: Collect &6Nether Gold&r, &cNetherite Scrap&r and &dAncient Debris&r from the deeps.
&dAncient Debris&r spawns between &fY=8&r and &fY=22&r — use &eTNT chains&r or &bBeds&r to reveal it.
Smelt scraps and combine with &6Gold Ingots&r to forge &5Netherite Ingots&r.
quest.1000000000000040.title: &5Tourist&r
quest.1000000000000040.quest_desc: &aBring an &fElytra&r or &fEnder Pearls&r — gaps over lava are unforgiving.
quest.1000000000000050.title: &cNether Fortress&r
quest.1000000000000050.quest_desc: Locate a &cNether Fortress&r — the only natural source of &7Wither Skeletons&r and &eBlaze Rods&r.
&eBlaze Rods&r are mandatory for &dPotions&r and the &5End Portal&r.
quest.3FAF5DE432E71EBF.title: &6Bastion Raider&r
quest.3FAF5DE432E71EBF.quest_desc: Find a &cBastion Remnant&r — &cPiglin&r strongholds packed with treasure.
&aWear at least one piece of &6Gold&r armor to avoid hostility.
quest.1000000000000093.title: &6Lava Walker&r
quest.1000000000000093.quest_desc: Mount a &eStrider&r and ride it across a lava lake.
Use a &cWarped Fungus on a Stick&r to steer — craft it with a &fFishing Rod&r and &dWarped Fungus&r.
&aA fast, fuel-free way to cross &cBasalt Deltas&r and lava oceans.
quest.1000000000000300.title: &5Towers of Hell&r
quest.1000000000000300.quest_desc: Discover the &7three Nether towers&r added by &eStructory&r:
Each holds &6unique loot&r and dangerous &cmobs&r. Climb to the top for the best chests.
quest.minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.qu: &8Wither Skeletons&r drop their skull with a &c~2.5% chance&r per kill.
&aLooting III&r boosts the drop rate to &e~5.5%&r — bring an enchanted sword.
Three skulls are required to summon the &cWither&r.
quest.minecraft:flint_and_steel.title: &cThe Nether Call&r
quest.minecraft:flint_and_steel.quest_de: Build a &5Nether Portal&r (minimum &f4x5 Obsidian&r frame) and light it with &eFlint and Steel&r.
&aEnter the Nether&r to begin your descent into hell.
&7Bring &fGold armor&r, &fFire Resistance potions&r and &fObsidian&r in case your portal breaks.
quest.twilightforest:maze_map.title: &aMaze Map
quest.twilightforest:maze_map.quest_subt: Never get lost in the labyrinth again.
quest.twilightforest:maze_map.quest_desc: &7The &aMaze Map&7 reveals the walls and floor of any &eLabyrinth&7 around you.
Craft it with paper, a compass, and &emaze wafers&7 (found in Labyrinth chests).
&eHold it&7 while exploring the Minotaur's home to map your path back out and locate the &6Minoshroom&7 boss room.
&6Tip:&7 upgrade it to a &aMaze Map Focus&7 for a full Y-level overview.
quest.twilightforest:minoshroom_trophy.q: &7Drops from the &cMinoshroom&7, the axe-wielding bull lurking deep inside the &eLabyrinth&7.
Place it as a decorative head, or use it as a &6progression key&7 to unlock the next Twilight Forest tier.
&eDefeating the Minoshroom&7 lifts the curse that prevents you from entering the &dDark Forest&7 properly.
quest.twilightforest:magic_beans.title: &aMagic Beans
quest.twilightforest:magic_beans.quest_s: Plant a stalk that reaches the clouds.
quest.twilightforest:magic_beans.quest_d: &7Drop these on a &eGiant Obsidian&7 block under an open sky and a colossal &abeanstalk&7 will sprout.
Climb it to reach the floating &fCloud Cottage&7 where the &6Giants&7 dwell.
&eDefeating a Giant&7 awards &7Giant Pickaxes and Giant Swords. The cottage is also the gateway to the &bAurora Palace&7 quest line.
quest.twilightforest:giant_pickaxe.title: &7Giant's Pickaxe
quest.twilightforest:giant_pickaxe.quest: &7Looted from a slain &fGiant&7 above the clouds.
Each swing breaks a &e4x4x4 cube&7 of stone, dirt, or similar blocks. Massive area mining at the cost of speed.
&eBest paired with:&7 Efficiency, Unbreaking, and Mending. Perfect for clearing quarry pits or strip-mining caves.
quest.twilightforest:lamp_of_cinders.que: Burn away the Twilight Forest's curses.
&7Crafted from &eFiery Ingots&7 after defeating the &cUr-Ghast&7 atop the Dark Tower.
Right-click to project a &6flame&7 that destroys &cThorn blocks&7 and &eDark Tower foliage&7, opening paths previously sealed by the forest's curse.
&eRequired&7 to progress toward the &bAurora Palace&7 and the &dFinal Castle&7.
quest.twilightforest:experiment_115.ques: &7Earned by completing the &eTwilight Dinner&7 advancement (eat every Twilight food).
&dExperiment 115&7 is a pink, regenerating cake that &arestores its own slices over time&7 while in your inventory.
&eEach slice&7 grants saturation and a brief &aRegeneration&7 buff.
&6A near-infinite food source for long expeditions.
